findings.title: A same-folder PNG+JPG duplicate is not resolved 'PNG first' by RimWorld, contrary to the new comment
findings.detail: ModContentHolder.ReloadAll keeps the FIRST item LoadAllForMod yields for an extension-less path and logs 'Tried to load duplicate' for the rest. Within one folder that order is GetAllFilesForMod's dictionary insertion order: DirectoryInfo.GetFiles order, which depends on the filesystem (alphabetical on NTFS, so .jpeg/.jpg come before .png). The TextureExtensions comment says a PNG is preferred within one folder, and ReadPng may then decode a PNG that is not the texture on screen. The width/height check catches it only when the sizes differ. This only happens with a mod that already gets a duplicate-load warning, so it is rare. The single change: reword the comment so it does not claim RimWorld prefers the PNG (or return null when a folder holds more than one non-dds hit).

findings.title: File.Exists with lowercase extensions misses a retexture's .PNG/.DDS on case-sensitive filesystems
findings.detail: RimWorld accepts texture extensions case-insensitively (IsAcceptableExtension lowercases, and the dds shadow set uses ToLowerInvariant). The probe here builds rel + ".dds" etc. and calls File.Exists, which is case-sensitive on Linux. A higher-priority mod shipping X.DDS or X.PNG is then skipped, and the loop falls through to an earlier mod's PNG: the art-swap this diff was written to prevent. Only the size check guards it. The single change: list the folder's files that start with the texture name and compare Path.GetExtension with OrdinalIgnoreCase instead of File.Exists per extension.

findings.title: ReadPng's doc comment no longer describes when it returns null
findings.detail: The summary says it returns null when there is no PNG or the size does not match. It now also returns null on purpose when the winning mod holds a .dds or a non-PNG, so that the GPU copy is read. Update the summary so the next reader does not 'fix' that early return.
